Briefing
Watch for
Watch for digestive symptoms such as bloating, cramping, loose stools, or unusual gurgling after consuming cow milk, and note whether any reaction appears within the first hour or builds more gradually over several hours. Log the timing and character of each symptom as precisely as you can, since the pattern of onset is just as important as the symptom itself.
One tip
Keep your exposure day simple by pairing cow milk only with foods you have already confirmed as safe, so that your digestive response stays clearly attributable to the milk itself.
Stop immediately if
STOP immediately and seek medical care if you experience difficulty breathing, throat tightening, facial or throat swelling, hives, or vomiting at any point during this reintroduction.
